scope: Kernel feature revision 10; program image ABI revision remains 2. FACTOR_ENERGY_TAP (25) returns an unpatched factor range tap, raw factor-square SUM_ACC energy, and a tail-nonzero flag.
support_encoding: unscaled S27 integer indices, 0..1023; explicit lengths; deterministic ties use lower original index
flags: support_flags are bit masks; all unassigned bits fault

support_response.count: support cardinality S for APPLY_SUPPORT/SCATTER; actual packed length for TOPK/UNION/GATHER; zero for PICK
support_response.length: adjunct publication length: N for APPLY_SUPPORT/SCATTER, packed length for TOPK/UNION/GATHER, zero for PICK

transaction: one accepted command; held response; speculative writes publish together; cancel flushes silently; host access only when host_enable and core idle

numeric_rules.NORMALIZE: loaded MAC S27xS27, input A vector and input B scalar_a; raw product round_right(req_shift) once per element
numeric_rules.GEMV: loaded MAC C18 mode, input A vector B coefficient, R4 sum four raw lanes then round16 once
numeric_rules.STORE: loaded MOV A; INTERNAL identity, X24 round2 and checked24 then embed<<2, D18 round8 and checked18 then embed<<8
numeric_rules.SOFT: loaded SUB A/B; scalar_a nonnegative threshold, signed subtraction uses shared PEs then deadzone clamp
numeric_rules.TEMPLATE: exact revision-one descriptor/context semantics, optional scalar input binding masks; explicit frame_count/tail_mask
numeric_rules.RANGE_TEMPLATE: ordinary loaded TEMPLATE arithmetic over command-scoped source A/B element offsets; selected packed lanes only; product, partial ACC, terminal reduction, rounding and checked S27 semantics are identical to TEMPLATE
numeric_rules.ROUNDED_AFFINE: explicit loaded cascade16: high result C plus or minus the low MUL product rounded once to S27; no public intermediate publication
numeric_rules.FACTOR_RANGE_TEMPLATE: direct mode1 MAC S27 factor lane times public source A, SUM_ACC mode2 raw signed ACC64; no per-lane round or rescale; optional signed S27 patch replaces factor range head before MAC and candidate tap
numeric_rules.FACTOR_ENERGY_TAP: direct mode1 MAC S27 factor lane times itself, SUM_ACC mode2 raw signed ACC64; candidate tap preserves the unpatched factor range and count returns whether any tail lane is nonzero; no per-lane round or rescale

range_transport.length: full source A domain N in 1..1024
range_transport.index: start in 0..N; N permitted only when aux_length is zero
range_transport.SLICE: packed A[start:start+L], output length and count L; empty range touches no output
range_transport.REPLACE_RANGE: full N output, A outside range and packed aux_base[0:L] inside; output length/count N
range_transport.flags: zero; support_base/support_length/k must be zero; src_b ignored; SLICE aux_base ignored
range_transport.publication: scratch only until complete; source/destination/aux aliases safe
range_transport.SCALAR_INSERT: full source A length N with exactly one lane index replaced by scalar_a S27F22; no auxiliary-pool read; result count/length N

factor_transport.shape: dense B rows1..128, cols1..96 with captured key/generation/job/fmt
factor_transport.FACTOR_INIT: length=M, index=aux_length=flags=0, no pool publication; count=S
factor_transport.FACTOR_READ: length=L1..128, index=fixed row/column, aux_length=range start, flags bit0 row, packed outputL
factor_transport.FACTOR_WRITE: same coordinates, source A packedL, no pool publication; count=L
factor_transport.FACTOR_RANGE_TEMPLATE: length=L1..128, index=fixed factor row/column, aux_length=common factor/public offset, flags bit0 row bit1 head-only tap bit2 patch-first; source A selected offset..offset+L; descriptor23 all MAC297 SUM_ACC mode2; candidate length/count L or1 and raw ACC64 response
factor_transport.FACTOR_ENERGY_TAP: length=L1..128, index=fixed factor row/column, aux_length=range start, flags bit0 row; no public source; descriptor23 all MAC297 SUM_ACC mode2; unpatched packed candidate length L, raw ACC64 energy response and count tail-nonzero flag

scalar_template.scope: Single checked S27 result via existing PE lane0; no vector-memory transaction
scalar_template.sources: Selected A/B buses must be scalar-bound; IMM/ZERO allowed; MOV ignores source B
scalar_template.descriptor: EACH and shift0; increment bits ignored
scalar_template.result: Sign-extended S27 to rsp_data, nonzero flag, count0
scalar_template.compatibility: Additive opcode; original opcodes and program image revision2 retain semantics

factor_panel.shape: private dense factor image M1..128 by S1..96; immutable selected B identity and mutable factor image
factor_panel.FACTOR_MATVEC: source A packed row_count S27 values; q[c]=round22(sum increasing r factor[row_start+r,col_start+c]*A[r]); publishes packed S27 q length column_count
factor_panel.FACTOR_RANK1: source A packed row_count S27 values and B packed column_count S27 values; private factor[r,c]=checked_S27(factor[r,c]-round22(A[r]*B[c])); no public vector publication
factor_panel.validation: dense fmt1, nonempty in-range rectangle, exact key/generation/job/format, every source block validated before any mutation; cancel/fault invalidates factor image
factor_panel.panels: MATVEC internal width<=32; RANK1 internal width<=16 through existing two-array cascade; no QR-specific state machine
factor_panel.FACTOR_PROJECT_UPDATE: source A packed reflector V length=row_count; scalar_a alpha S27F22; q=round22(A^T V), q=round22(alpha*q), private factor[r,c]=checked_S27(factor[r,c]-round22(V[r]*q[c])); descriptor31 compact phase context; count/length zero and no public candidate
factor_panel.project_template: descriptor31 kind3 increment A/B/destination with bind masks zero; contexts [direct MAC mode1 A/B, direct MUL mode1 A/B, direct SUB mode1 A/B, 29*zero]; accepted only by FACTOR_PROJECT_UPDATE feature5

range_template.length: L1..1024 selected output elements; tail mask is contiguous L tail
range_template.offsets: index is source A element offset and aux_length is source B element offset; both are unsigned RF values in0..1023 and are not output lengths
range_template.template: ordinary loaded TEMPLATE descriptor with increment A/B/destination low3bits=7; EACH, LAST_ACC or SUM_ACC output kinds and existing context/shift/scalar rules
range_template.canonical_unused: dense, transpose, r4, flags, store_mode, k, support descriptors/lengths, shift register and target are zero; unused support/aux raw buses are literal zero
range_template.validation: selected source lanes only, widened offset plus highest selected lane plus one capacity arithmetic, unused RAM source offset0/no read, source/destination aliases retain pre-command mappings
range_template.transport: command-scoped public logical-to-physical packed lane assembly; no persistent view/alias handle; vector output uses existing scratch, validity and atomic commit

rounded_affine.formula: Z[i] = C[i] plus or minus round_S27(X[i] times Y[i]); SUB order is C minus rounded product
rounded_affine.shape: length L1..1024; descriptor EACH with increment A/B/destination bits 0..2 set; two paired 16-lane cascade frames per logical block
rounded_affine.sources: src_a X; src_b optional vector Y or scalar_b through lower-half bindB; aux_base C with canonical aux_length zero and C span derived from length; destination Z
rounded_affine.contexts: low16 MUL mode1 A/B; high16 ADD or SUB mode1 A/B; lower scalar bindB exactly 16hffff for scalar Y and high bindB zero; all reserved/immediate words zero
rounded_affine.canonical_unused: support base/length, flags, k, index, matrix controls, store mode, shift, scalar A and response scalar/flag controls are zero
rounded_affine.transaction: all X/Y/C selected source masks validate before CONFIG; source aliases use pre-command maps; scratch/remap publishes only final Z; cancel/fault invalidates Z only
rounded_affine.compatibility: explicit opt-in opcode; prior calls and program ABI revision2 retain their publication semantics

factor_range_template.shape: length L1..128; factor rows M1..128, cols S1..96; index is fixed factor axis and aux_length is common factor/public offset
factor_range_template.sources: src_a public selected range [aux_length, aux_length+length); src_b raw zero; scalar_a signed S27 patch only when flags.patch_first; all unused source and scalar fields zero
factor_range_template.axis_bounds: column: index<S and aux_length+length<=M; row: index<M and aux_length+length<=S; source A capacity covers aux_length+length before truncation
factor_range_template.template: descriptor23, all32 contexts MAC297 mode1 A/B, bind masks zero, SUM_ACC terminal mode2, shift0; raw terminal ACC64 no additional round
factor_range_template.tap: dst candidate tap has actual length/count length or one; full tap emits patched factor range, head-only emits selected head; raw scalar response is independent
factor_range_template.transaction: validate factor metadata/head/source range before fabric feed; retain at most four32-lane slots through validated raw DONE; drain candidate only on successful commit; cancel/fault/malformed reply publishes neither scalar nor partial tap
factor_range_template.compatibility: explicit feature9 opcode; prior operations and program ABI revision2 retain semantics

factor_energy_tap.shape: length L1..128; factor rows M1..128, cols S1..96; index is fixed factor axis and aux_length is range start
factor_energy_tap.sources: no public input; raw src_a/src_b, support/aux bases, scalar A/B, bind masks, shift, k, matrix transport and response target are zero
factor_energy_tap.axis_bounds: column: index<S and aux_length+length<=M; row: index<M and aux_length+length<=S; widened bounds before truncation
factor_energy_tap.template: descriptor23, all32 contexts MAC297 mode1 A/B, bind masks zero, SUM_ACC terminal mode2, shift0; raw terminal ACC64 no additional round
factor_energy_tap.response: dst candidate is the unpatched full factor range of exact length L; dst_s receives raw sum of signed factor squares; count is one iff any factor lane after the first is nonzero and is copied to flag_s with target count mode; dst_s and flag_s must be distinct nonzero RF destinations
factor_energy_tap.transaction: validate factor metadata/range before feed; retain at most four32-lane slots through raw DONE; publish candidate, raw scalar and tail flag together only on successful commit; cancel/fault/malformed reply publishes none
factor_energy_tap.compatibility: explicit feature10 opcode; prior operations and program ABI revision2 retain semantics
